blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL)后培训大大提高了扩散变压器的视觉质量、文本渲染和组成精度。 由于渲染所请求的文本或组合多个对象等能力本质上是即时的依赖,一个自然假设是,改进它们需要学习复杂,投入依赖的转换. 为了隔离这些收益中有多少是输入式独立转换解释,我们用一个刻意简单的参数化来探索每个RL调制模型:在冻结基模型的块输出中添加了一组固定的导向器. 在SD3.5-M上,这些矢量的参数比RL调值的LORA(0.29M对18.8M)少65x. 我们适合它们与公共RL调整检查站的速度预测相匹配,目标没有奖励. 虽然每个即时,令牌和采样种子的矢量相同,但是它们回收了6个RL调图图像模型的奖励收益的90.0%-96.3%,两个RL调图视频模型的奖励收益的89.8%和111.9%. 初始化为零,并接受在线RL训练,单向量超过SD3.5-M上基于重量的RL在文本渲染(OCR)和人类偏好(PickScore)上的奖励收益. 因此,不断转变就足够了政策性RL后培训的大部分收益:没有新的依赖投入的转换,它就引导预先培训的生成器向它已经可以计算的东西前进。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training [ 5 , 14 , 37 , 71 , 73 ] improves text rendering [ 37 ] , compositional accuracy [ 19 , 23 ] and human preference scores [ 26 , 66 , 41 , 69 ] in image and video diffusion transformers [ 13 , 6 , 63 ] . These improvements are typically obtained by updating the model’s weights, either through parameter-efficient adapters such as LoRA [ 22 ] or through full fine-tuning [ 71 ] . Although the update Δ ​ 𝐖 \Delta\mathbf{W} is fixed after training, the updated weights 𝐖 + Δ ​ 𝐖 \mathbf{W}+\Delta\mathbf{W} act on each token’s input, so different prompts and tokens produce different activation changes. This flexibility seems natural for visual generation, where the words to render and the objects to compose change with every prompt. But is this input dependence actually necessary to obtain the gains of RL post-training?
blocks.zh: 强化学习(RL) 后训练[5,14,37,71,73] 改进文本渲染[37],成分精度[19,23],以及人类偏好分数[26,66,41,69]在图像和视频传播变压器[13,6,63]. 这些改进通常是通过更新模型的权重,或者通过LORA[22]等参数高效的适配器,或者通过完全微调[71]获得. 虽然更新的QQ W\Delta\ mathbf{W}在训练后是固定的,但更新的权重W +\ mathbf{W\Delta\mathbf{W}在每个符的输入上行动,因此不同的提示和符符产生不同的激活变化. 这种灵活性对于视觉生成来说似乎是自然的,在那里,要渲染的单词和要用每个提示来编曲的物体. 但是,这种投入依赖性是否实际上是必要的,以获得培训后RL的收益?

blocks.en: Surprisingly, we find that most of the reward improvement of a diverse collection of RL-tuned image and video generators can be reproduced by freezing every pretrained weight and adding a small set of fixed steering vectors to the model’s activations. We fit these vectors to match the velocity predictions of each RL-tuned model, with no reward in the objective; simply averaging the activation changes that RL induces recovers far less of the gain. For a given RL-tuned model, the same vectors are used for every prompt, every sampling seed, and every token (Fig. 2 ). In total, they have 1.5% of the parameters of a rank-32 LoRA on SD3.5-M, and they do not depend on the requested text, objects, or composition. Yet they can make the frozen generator render requested phrases, satisfy compositional constraints and improve preference scores much as its RL-tuned counterpart does (Figs. 1 and 5 ). On six RL-tuned image models spanning SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev, multiple RL algorithms, LoRA and full fine-tuning, and rewards including PickScore, HPSv2.1, OCR, and GenEval, these fixed activation shifts recover 90.0–96.3% of the RL reward gain. The result extends to video: on two RL-tuned video generators, the same intervention recovers 89.8% and 111.9% of the gain.
blocks.zh: 令人惊讶的是,我们发现,通过冻结每个预先训练过的重量,并在模型的激活中添加一小组固定方向矢量,可以复制对多种RL调制图像和视频生成器的奖励改进。 我们适应这些向量,以匹配每个RL调制模型的速度预测,在目标上没有回报;简单地平均RL诱导的激活变化,回收得远不如收益. 对于一个给定的RL调制模型,每个速率,每个采样种子,每个符号(图2)都使用相同的矢量. 它们总共拥有SD3.5-M上的一级-32LORA参数的1.5%,它们并不依赖于所请求的文本,对象或组成. 然而,它们可以使冷冻生成器渲染所请求的短语,满足组成限制,并与其RL调制的对应器一样,提高偏好分数(图1和图5)。 在跨越SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev的6个RL调图像模型上,多个RL算法,LORA和全微调,以及包括PickScore,HPSv2.1,OCR,和GenEval在内的奖励,这些固定激活班次回收了90.0-96.3%的RL奖励收益. 结果延伸至视频:在两台RL调频视频发电机上,同样的干预回收了89.8%和111.9%的收益.

blocks.en: We next ask whether RL can learn such constant shifts directly from the reward in diffusion transformers. We freeze the generator and run Flow-GRPO [ 37 ] with only the steering vectors trainable, starting from zero. The trained vectors reach 104.6% and 103.6% of the gains of the OCR-tuned and PickScore-tuned SD3.5-M models, so RL achieves both gains by learning only a small set of constant vectors, without updating any pretrained weight.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来问RL是否能够从扩散变压器的奖励中直接学到这种恒定的转变. 我们冻结了发电机,运行Flow-GRPO [37] 只有方向矢量可以训练,从零开始. 经过训练的矢量达到OCR调制和PickScore调制的SD3.5-M模型的104.6%和103.6%,因此RL通过只学习一小组恒定矢量而实现两种增益,而无需更新任何预先训练的重量.

blocks.en: How can one constant intervention produce different improvements for different prompts? The steering vectors carry no prompt information, so the prompt-specific part of the change must come from the frozen generator. Inside the transformer, attention, normalization and MLP layers mix the constant vector with prompt-dependent representations, so its effect on the output can depend strongly on the prompt. On SD3.5-M, we trace how the shift reaches the image: through what image tokens read from text tokens in joint attention. When image tokens read the text keys and values of the unsteered base model instead, with everything else unchanged, most of the OCR and PickScore gains disappear. The same replacement removes most of the gains of the OCR-tuned and PickScore-tuned models, so the steering vectors and RL reach the image by the same route. The text stream, the conditional guidance pass and the early sampling steps carry most of the gain: vectors fitted to these parts alone, with 531 × \times fewer parameters than the rank-32 LoRA, recover 89.5% of the RL gain on OCR and 73.7% on PickScore ( Sec. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 一次不断的干预如何能够为不同的提示带来不同的改进? 方向矢量不携带即时信息,因此变化的即时特定部分必须来自冷冻生成器. 变压器内部,注意力,正常化和MLP层将常量向量与即时依赖的表示物混合,因此其对输出的影响可以强烈地依赖于即时. 在SD3.5-M上,我们追踪转变是如何到达图像的:通过什么图像符号从文字符号读取在联合关注中. 当图像符号读取未调试的基模型的文本密钥和值,其他一切不变时,大部分OCR和PickScore增益就消失了. 同样的置换取消了OCR调制和PickScore调制模型的大部分收益,因此方向向量和RL通过同一路由到达图像. 文字流,有条件的制导通道和早期的采样步骤携带了大部分收益:仅这些部分就配有矢量,参数比排名-32的LORA少了531×\时,回收OCR上89.5%的RL收益和PickScore上73.7%(sec.5).

blocks.en: These results suggest a different view of RL post-training in visual generators: a constant shift suffices to steer generation toward most of the RL gain, and the frozen generator does the prompt-specific work. Although RL’s weight updates produce input-dependent activation changes, most of their reward gain is reproduced without new input-dependent transformations beyond those the base model already computes. Our main contributions are:
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,对视觉发电机的RL后训练有不同的看法:恒定的转变足以引导发电量向大部分RL收益的方向发展,而冷冻发电机则进行即时特定的工作. 虽然RL的重量更新会产生依赖输入的激活变化,但大部分的奖励增益都是复制的,除了基础模型已经计算出来的外,没有新的依赖输入的转换. 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • We show that fixed steering vectors, fitted with no reward in the objective, recover most of the gain of eight RL-tuned image and video models, including two full fine-tunes. • We find that matching the RL-tuned model’s velocity recovers far more of the gain than adding its average activation change. • We train only the steering vectors of a frozen SD3.5-M with Flow-GRPO and exceed the reward gains of the RL-tuned OCR and PickScore models, with images rated on par with theirs in a user study. • We trace how a constant shift yields prompt-specific gains: on SD3.5-M, it reaches the image through what image tokens read from text, as RL’s change does.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们显示,固定方向矢量在目标中没有奖赏,可以回收8个RL调图图像和视频模型的大部分收益,包括两个全微调。 我们发现,与RL调制模型的速度相匹配的恢复收益远大于增加其平均激活变化。 我们只用Flow-GRPO来训练冷冻的SD3.5-M的引导矢量,并超过RL调制OCR和PickScore模型的奖励收益,在用户研究中将图像评分与它们相等。 我们追踪恒定变换如何产生迅速的具体收益:在SD3.5-M上,它通过从文本读取的图像符号到达图像,就像RL的变化那样。

blocks.zh: 我们显示,固定方向矢量在目标中没有奖赏,它回收了8个RL调图图像和视频模型的大部分收益,包括两个完整的微调.

blocks.en: We train only the steering vectors of a frozen SD3.5-M with Flow-GRPO and exceed the reward gains of the RL-tuned OCR and PickScore models, with images rated on par with theirs in a user study.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
RL post-training of diffusion transformers. Reward fine-tuning raises a score of a diffusion model’s samples by backpropagating the score through the sampler [ 11 , 51 ] , by learning from preference pairs [ 62 ] or with policy gradients [ 5 , 14 ] .
Policy gradients [ 64 ] need only one score per sample, and their group-relative form in Flow-GRPO [ 37 ] and DanceGRPO [ 71 ] now post-trains image and video diffusion transformers [ 13 , 6 , 63 ] .
The rewards include OCR accuracy [ 37 ] , GenEval [ 19 ] and T2I-CompBench [ 23 ] scores, and preference models trained on human judgments [ 10 , 26 , 66 , 69 , 41 ] .
Other studies report side effects on color saturation [ 45 ] and output diversity [ 3 ] .
We ask what RL changes inside the model to produce these gains.
blocks.zh:
RL 扩散变压器的后培训. 奖励微调通过采样者[11,51]背面宣传分数,通过学习偏好对[62]或用政策梯度[5,14]来提高扩散模型样本的分数.
政策梯度[64]每个样本只需要一个分数,其分组相对形式为Flow-GRPO[37]和DanceGRPO[71],现在为后传图像和视频传播变压器[13,6,63].
奖励包括OCR精度[37],GenEval[19]和T2I-Comp Bench[23]分数,以及受人判断训练的偏好模型[10,26,66,69,41].
其他研究报告了对颜色饱和度[45]和输出多样性的副作用[3].
我们问RL在模型中有什么变化来产生这些收益.

blocks.en:
Where RL acts. Studies of RL in language models ask where its update sits.
RL fine-tuning updates a small subnetwork [ 44 ] , reaches most of its gain with few trained parameters [ 43 ] and keeps the model close to the base model [ 52 ] .
Alignment tuning mainly changes the stylistic or first tokens of each answer [ 34 , 48 ] , and RL raises the probability of answers that the base model already samples [ 72 ] .
Venhoff et al . [ 61 ] close most of the gap to RL-trained reasoning models with classifier-gated steering vectors: a classifier decides where to add each reasoning behavior.
Sinii et al . [ 55 , 54 ] train steering vectors with RL on a math reward and match or nearly match full RL fine-tuning, and Vakada et al . [ 60 ] do the same with label-free rewards.
We fit ours to a given RL-tuned model to measure how much of its gain a constant recovers, and also train them with the reward ( Sec. 4.6 ).
We study diffusion transformers, in which a reward gain is a prompt-specific change of a whole image or video.
blocks.zh:
RL行动的地方. 语言模型中RL的研究问其更新位置在哪里.
RL微调更新了一个小的子网络[44],以很少经过训练的参数达到它的大部分收益[43],并使模型接近基准模型[52].
对齐调制主要改变每个回答[34,48]的字形或首字母符号,RL提高答案概率,基础模型已经对[72]进行采样.
Venhoff et al. [61] 将大部分空白与 RL 训练的推理模型相近,并带有分类器加成的引导矢量:一个分类器决定添加每个推理行为的地方.
Sinii et al. [55,54] 搭载RL的列车方向矢量进行数学奖励,并匹配或几乎匹配全RL的微调, Vakada et al. [60] 以无标签奖励同样.
我们适合给定的RL调制模式,以衡量其持续恢复的多少收益,并用奖励来训练他们(第4.6节)。
我们研究扩散变压器,其中奖励收益是整个图像或视频的迅速具体变化.

blocks.en:
Activation steering. Activation steering adds a fixed vector to a model’s hidden states, taken from contrasting prompts [ 58 , 31 , 49 , 74 ] or optimized [ 56 , 8 ] .
In image models, a fixed direction in deep features edits image content [ 59 ] , and similar, often gated, additions steer diffusion models [ 29 , 15 ] and diffusion transformers [ 27 ] .
Task arithmetic [ 25 ] adds the weight difference of a fine-tuned model, which is constant in weight space but changes the activations of each input differently.
In concurrent work, First-Order Steering [ 28 ] turns such a weight update into steering vectors to first order.
Adila et al . [ 1 ] find the block output, where our steering vectors sit, an expressive place for such shifts.
We instead fit steering vectors to the velocity predictions of a given RL-tuned model.
blocks.zh:
激活方向盘。 激活方向盘在模型的隐藏状态中添加了固定的矢量,取自对比的提示 [58, 31, 49, 74] 或优化 [56, 8].
在图像模型中,深层特征的固定方向会编辑图像内容[59],以及相似的,常加门的,添加的向导扩散模型[29,15]和扩散变压器[27].
任务算术 [25] 添加了微调模型的重量差,这个模型在重量空间上是恒定的,但改变每个输入的激活方式不同.
在同时进行的工作中,第一指令引导[28]将这种权重更新变为方向矢量为第一顺序.
Adila et al. [1] 找到我们方向矢量所在的块输出,是这种转向的表达地.
相反,我们把引导向量与特定RL调制模型的速度预测相匹配。

blocks.en:
Constants in a network. Many adaptation methods change a frozen model through parameters that are the same for every input.
At the input, prompt tuning [ 30 ] trains soft prompt tokens, textual inversion [ 16 ] fits a word for a new concept and ReNeg [ 32 ] learns a negative embedding on a reward.
RaTE [ 9 ] fits one prompt token to a Flow-GRPO model by flow matching.
Inside the network, prefix tuning [ 33 ] and P-Tuning v2 [ 39 ] prepend learned keys and values to attention layers, and ReFT [ 67 ] learns interventions on hidden representations.
BitFit [ 4 ] and (IA) 3 [ 36 ] train biases and channel scales, DiffFit [ 68 ] tunes the biases and scales of a diffusion transformer and Calibri [ 57 ] tunes the block gates of diffusion transformers on a reward.
BitFit and DiffFit train biases with the task loss to adapt a model to new data, whereas we fit steering vectors at the block outputs to an existing RL-tuned model to measure how much of its gain they reproduce.
blocks.zh:
网络中的常数。 许多适应方法通过每个输入都相同的参数改变一个冷冻模型.
在输入时,即时调音[30]列车软速指示符,文字反转[16]适合一个新概念的单词,ReNeg[32]学习在奖励上嵌入阴性.
RaTE[9]通过流量匹配与Flow-GRPO模型匹配一个即时符号.
网络内部,前缀调 [33] 和 P-Tuning v2 [39] 预先将学到的键和值放入关注层,ReFT [67] 学习关于隐藏表达的干预.
BitFit [4]和(IA) 3 [36] 列车偏差和信道天平,DiffFit [68] 调用散射变压器的偏差和天平,Calibri[57] 调用散射变压器的挡门,奖励.
BitFit 和 DiffFit 列车偏差为任务损失,将一个模型适应新数据,而我们在块输出时将方向矢量与现有的 RL 调制模型相匹配,以测量它们复制的多少收益.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

Diffusion transformers. The base model, the RL-tuned model and the steered base model are diffusion transformers [ 46 ] trained by flow matching [ 40 , 35 ] .

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
Table 1 lists the eight RL-tuned models, all public checkpoints released by their authors.
On SD3.5-M, Flow-GRPO [ 37 ] gives the OCR-tuned and GenEval-tuned models and the PickScore-tuned model with and without the KL penalty.
On FLUX.1-dev [ 6 ] , Flow-GRPO tunes a LoRA for PickScore, and DanceGRPO [ 71 ] fine-tunes all weights for HPSv2.1 [ 66 ] .
The Wan2.1 RL-tuned model is a GenRL [ 18 ] LoRA on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B [ 63 ] , trained with the LongCat-Video recipe [ 42 ] on HPSv3 [ 41 ] and VideoAlign [ 38 ] rewards.
The VBVR-Pro RL-tuned model fine-tunes all weights of its base model VBVR-Pro [ 70 ] , a supervised fine-tune of Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, by RL with a verifiable rule-based reward (RLVR).
Of the six public RL-tuned video models we evaluated, only these two gain on the evaluated reward with a 95% interval above zero ( Tab. S13 ).
We evaluate each SD3.5-M RL-tuned model on the test set of its reward, the two FLUX.1-dev RL-tuned models on the PickScore test prompts, the Wan2.1 RL-tuned model on VBench [ 24 ] test prompts and the VBVR-Pro RL-tuned model on in-domain test instances that the fit never uses, from its RL training tasks ( Tab. 1 ).
On FLUX.1-dev, the steering vectors are fitted on PickScore training prompts, so the PickScore test set holds out prompts from the same source.
A gain is a model’s mean raw reward minus the base model’s, from the same prompts and starting noise, with a paired 95% bootstrap interval.
We select each checkpoint on the reward’s validation set.
The appendix gives the hyperparameters ( Tab. S1 ), full prompts and more samples ( Sec. I ).

blocks.en:
The recovery also holds on prompts that the base model rarely solves.
For each of the four sampling seeds, we take the GenEval test prompts that the base model fails at the other three (146 prompts).
At the held-out seed, the base model succeeds on 14.9% of them, and the GenEval steering vectors recover 97.7% of the GenEval-tuned model’s + 0.641 +0.641 gain.
Likewise, of the test prompt-seed pairs that the base model fails and the RL-tuned model solves, the steering vectors solve 91.4% on GenEval and 75.3% on OCR, close to the 93.3% and 71.6% that the RL-tuned model itself solves at the next sampling seed ( Tab. S14 ).

在被搁置的种子上,基型在其中14.9%上成功,GenEval方向矢量回收了GenEval调制的型号的97.7%+0.641+0.641增益.
同样,在基准模型失败和RL调试模型解决的测试即时种子对中,方向矢量在GenEval上解决91.4%,在OCR上解决75.3%,接近RL调试模型自己在下一个采样种子上解决的93.3%和71.6%(Tab. S14).

A same-size input-dependent fit shows no detected advantage. We compare the steering vectors with a same-size LoRA, an input-dependent parameterization with as many parameters as 𝐬 \mathbf{s} , fitted by Eq. 2 on the same cached samples for the same number of updates ( Fig. 7(a) ).
On the SD3.5-M, VBVR-Pro and FLUX.1-dev models, the paired 95% interval of the difference between the LoRA and the steering vectors includes zero ( Tab. S5 ).
On Wan2.1, the same-size LoRA recovers 69.7% of the RL gain, against 111.9% for the steering vectors.

Supervised fine-tuning. In contrast with RL, steering vectors fall short when supervised fine-tuning teaches the base model a subject it cannot draw.
They recover 68% to 83% of the identity gain of DreamBooth [ 50 ] LoRAs for six fictional people and 73% to 95% of the subject-similarity gain of four public DreamBooth LoRAs, and a same-size LoRA recovers more ( Figs. 7(a) and E ).

blocks.en: 5 Where does the gain act?
blocks.zh: 页:1 进球在哪里?

blocks.en: To see how one shared shift yields prompt-specific gains, we fit restricted sets of steering vectors on SD3.5-M and test how the change crosses joint attention.
blocks.zh: 为了看一个共享的转变如何产生迅速的特异性收益,我们在SD3.5-M上安装了受限的几组方向矢量,并测试变化如何跨越联合关注.

blocks.en:
Finding 1. The gain favors the conditional pass, the early steps and the text stream. We fit each restricted set with the recipe and training length of the full set and evaluate it on the OCR and PickScore test sets at one sampling seed ( Fig. 7(b) ).
Steering vectors that act only on the conditional pass recover more of the RL gains than the full set ( Fig. 7(b) ), whereas the unconditional-pass vectors of a full set, added alone, lower both rewards ( Tab. S12 ).
The vectors of the two passes point in similar directions and guidance subtracts the unconditional pass, so without its vectors the net guided change grows, as with a larger α \alpha .
Fitted alone, either stream recovers most of the gain (91.4% on OCR and 84.9% on PickScore for the image stream).
Within the full set, however, the text-stream vectors carry most of the gain when added alone ( Tab. S12 ).
The early step bin carries far more of the gain than the late one.
With all three choices together, 35,328 parameters (12% of the full set, 0.19% of the rank-32 LoRA) recover 89.5% of the RL gain on OCR and 73.7% on PickScore.
blocks.zh:
查找 1. 收益有利于有条件的通过,早期步骤和文本流. 我们把每套受限设备与全套设备的配方和培训时间相匹配,并在一个取样种子(图7(b))的OCR和PickScore测试设备上进行评估。
仅根据有条件的通过进行操作的引导向量回收的RL增益多于整集(图7(b)),而仅添加一个整集的无条件通过向量则降低两个奖励(Tab.S12)。
两个通过点的矢量在类似的方向和引导中减去无条件的通过,所以没有它的矢量,净引导变化就会增长,就像一个更大的α\α.
单是装配,任一流都恢复了大部分收益(OCR为91.4%,图像流为84.9%PickScore)。
然而,在全套中,文本流矢量单加后就携带大部分增益(Tab.S12 )。
早期的步本携带着远多于晚期的收益.
加上所有三种选择,35,328个参数(全集12%,排名32 LoRA0.19%)在OCR上回收89.5%的RL增益,在PickScore上回收73.7%.

blocks.en:
Finding 2. The gain reaches the image through what image tokens read from text. The text-stream vectors shift text tokens only, and the velocity is projected from the image stream, so their change must reach the image through joint attention [ 13 ] , in which image and text tokens read the keys and values of both streams.
Replacing the text keys and values that image queries read with those of the unsteered base model on the same noisy state keeps only 20.5% of the steering vectors’ OCR gain and 10.5% of their PickScore gain ( Fig. 9 ).
The RL-tuned models rely on the same route, retaining 26.4% (OCR-tuned) and 24.5% (PickScore-tuned) of their gains under this intervention, whereas resetting what text tokens read from image tokens preserves at least 84.4% of all four gains.
On the OCR test prompt of Fig. S8 , reverting what image tokens read from text turns both models’ clean text back into the base model’s garbled text.
On PickScore, replacing what text tokens read from other text tokens leaves only 43.8% of the steering vectors’ gain and 40.9% of the RL-tuned model’s, versus 93.6% and 89.6% on OCR; preference gains thus also modify text tokens before image tokens read them, consistent with style reaching the image through text tokens [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
查找 2. 收益通过从文本读取的图像符号到达图像。 文本流矢量只转换文本符号,速度从图像流中预测,所以它们的改变必须通过联合关注[13]到达图像,其中图像和文本符号读取两个流的键和值.
将图像查询的文本密钥和值替换为在同样吵吵的状态上未触动的基模型的文本密钥和值,只保留了方向矢量的20.5%的OCR增益和10.5%的PickScore增益(图9).
RL调制模型依赖于相同的路由,在此干预下保留其收益的26.4%(OCR调制)和24.5%(PickScore调制),而重置从图像调制符读取的文本符号则至少保留了所有四个增制的84.4%.
在 Fig. S8 的 OCR 测试提示上, 将图像符号从文本中读到的文本返回到两个模型的干净文本中, 回到基模型的粘合文本中 。
在PickScore上,替换从其他文本符号读取的文本符号只留下43.8%的向量收益和40.9%的RL调制模型收益,而在OCR上则只有93.6%和89.6%;因此,偏好收益在图像符号读取之前也会修改文本符号,与通过文本符号到达图像的风格一致 [17] 。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
RL post-training updates the weights of a diffusion transformer, so it changes the activations differently for each prompt and token, as prompt-specific skills such as text rendering seem to require.
Yet steering vectors shared across all inputs and fitted with no reward in the objective recover most of the reward gain of six image and two video RL-tuned models.
Trained with Flow-GRPO on a frozen SD3.5-M, the vectors exceed the reward gains of the OCR-tuned and PickScore-tuned models, and a user study rates the resulting images on par with those of the RL-tuned models.
Most of the RL gain thus lies in a small set of constant vectors, which the frozen generator turns into prompt-specific images.
On SD3.5-M, the gain favors the conditional pass, the early steps and the text stream, and reaches the image through what image tokens read from text in joint attention.
We hypothesize that policy-gradient RL post-training primarily steers the base model toward what it can already compute.
It remains open whether optimizing these rewards benefits from new input-dependent transformations at all, or whether current RL methods cannot learn them.
All eight RL-tuned models use policy gradients, so preference optimization and reward backpropagation remain untested.
blocks.zh:
RL训练后更新了扩散变压器的权重,因此它会按照文字渲染等即时特异性技能似乎需要,对每个即时和代号的激活进行不同的改变.
然而,引导矢量在所有投入中共享,在目标中搭配无酬,回收了6个图像和2个视频RL调制模型的大部分奖励收益。
在冷冻的SD3.5-M上对Flow-GRPO进行了训练,矢量超过了OCR调制和PickScore调制模型的奖励收益,用户研究对产生的图像进行与RL调制模型相同的评分.
因此,大部分RL增益都存在于一小组恒定矢量上,被冻结的生成器会变成即时特异的图像.
在SD3.5-M上,增益偏好有条件的通过,早期的步骤和文本流,通过图像符号在联合关注中从文本读取的内容到达图像.
我们假设,政策性RL后培训主要引导基础模型走向它已经可以计算的东西。
能否从新的依赖投入的转变中获取最佳的回报,或者目前的RL方法是否无法学习这些回报,仍然有待研究。
所有8个RL调制模型都采用政策梯度,因此优惠优化和奖励回推广仍未经过测试.

blocks.en:
Table S5 compares the steering vectors with a same-size LoRA, fitted by Eq. 2 on the same cached samples for the same number of updates.
The SD3.5-M, Wan2.1 and Wan2.2-5B rows use the test sets of Tab. 1 .
A rank- r r LoRA adds r r fixed directions to each token, each weighted by a linear function of that token’s input, so the comparison tests whether input-dependent weights help at this size.
A rank-1 LoRA is thus a steering vector whose weight depends on the input.
On the five image rows and on the in-domain instances of VBVR-Pro, the paired 95% interval of the difference between the steering vectors and the LoRA includes zero.
On Wan2.1 it recovers 69.7% of the RL gain, against 111.9% for the steering vectors.
Truncating the RL-tuned models’ own LoRAs tests whether a rank-1 part of the RL weight update carries the gain.
On the test sets at two sampling seeds, the rank-1 LoRAs of the PickScore-tuned and OCR-tuned models gain + 0.668 +0.668 and + 0.210 +0.210 , against + 1.549 +1.549 and + 0.334 +0.334 for the full LoRAs, so rank 1 keeps only 43.1% and 62.8% of the gain.
A low-rank copy of the RL weight update therefore recovers less than the steering vectors.
Averaging the RL-tuned models’ own LoRA change tests how much of it is shared across inputs.
At each block, this change is the block output with the LoRA minus the block output without it, both on the RL-tuned model’s block input.
We average it over the tokens of 1,024 noisy states from training prompts, in the layout of 𝐬 \mathbf{s} , and add only this average to the base model’s block outputs.
On two noisy states of each of 512 prompts, the average closes 62.5% [61.1, 63.8] of the mean squared velocity gap between the base and PickScore-tuned models and 30.8% [30.0, 31.8] of the gap to the OCR-tuned model, with 95% bootstrap intervals over prompts.
Adding the full change at every block closes all of it.
The direction of 𝐬 fit \mathbf{s}_{\mathrm{fit}} also matters: random vectors, each rescaled to the norm of the steering vector it replaces, lower the base model’s PickScore by 4.704 points on the PickScore test set, where the steering vectors raise it by 1.416.
A random change of the RL update’s size tests whether the fit recovers any small change of the weights as well as it recovers RL’s.
In each LoRA layer of the PickScore-tuned and OCR-tuned models, we replace the trained output factor by a Gaussian matrix with 4.5 times its Frobenius norm, which brings the base model’s loss in Eq. 2 to 0.957 and 1.586 times its loss to the RL-tuned model.
We fit steering vectors to each random copy with the recipe of Tab. S1 for 4,500 updates, at one training seed.
On held-out states of the fit, the steering vectors lower the loss of Eq. 2 by 86.5% for the PickScore-tuned model and 68.8% for the OCR-tuned model, against 44.0% and 32.6% for the random copies.
On separately drawn noisy states from other prompts, the steering vectors close 88.4% [87.2, 89.4] of the mean squared velocity gap between the base and PickScore-tuned models, and 68.9% [67.0, 70.7] of the gap to the OCR-tuned model, so they recover the reward gain without matching the RL-tuned model’s velocity exactly.
The fit thus matches the change that RL makes about twice as closely as a random change of the same layout and size.

blocks.en:
DreamBooth [ 50 ] teaches a model a new subject by supervised fine-tuning on a few images, not by RL.
We fit steering vectors to four public DreamBooth LoRAs whose subjects the base model cannot draw, one on SD3.5-M and three on FLUX.1-dev.
Each fit follows the main recipe for 1,500 updates with one training seed.
Subject similarity is the DINOv3 [ 53 ] similarity of an image to the closest training image of the subject.
On 25 held-out prompts with the trigger word at four sampling seeds, the steering vectors reach 73% to 95% of the DreamBooth LoRA’s similarity gain over the base model.
They reproduce the subject’s coarse appearance but miss fine identity details, such as the painted face of a cat toy ( Fig. S5 ) and the thorns of a cactus character.
A LoRA with as many parameters as the steering vectors reaches 94% to 100% of the gain and keeps these details more often.
Without the trigger word, the steering vectors’ similarity gain is below the DreamBooth LoRA’s own or not detectably different from it.
A public subject may already be partly known to the base model.
We therefore also create six fictional people, three women and three men.
Qwen-Image [ 65 ] draws one portrait of each person from a written description, and FLUX.1 Kontext [ 7 ] redraws that person in nine further scenes.
A DreamBooth LoRA of FLUX.1-dev learns each person from these ten images, and the steering vectors and the same-size LoRA are fitted to it as above.
Identity similarity is the ArcFace [ 12 ] cosine similarity of the largest face in an image to the closest training image.
On the 25 held-out prompts at four sampling seeds, the steering vectors recover 68% to 83% of the DreamBooth LoRA’s identity gain, and the same-size LoRA 81% to 91% ( Tabs. S7 and S6 ).
Supervised fine-tuning on a new subject thus needs more than a constant shift, whereas RL post-training does not ( Sec. 4.2 ).

DreamBooth[50]通过在少数图像上监督的微调,而不是由RL来教授一个模型的新科目.
我们把方向向量配对到四个公共的DreamBooth LoRAs, 其主题是基础模型无法绘制的, 一个在SD3.5-M, 三个在FLUX.1-dev。
每套都遵循1500种更新的主要配方,并配有一个训练种子.
主体相似性是DINov3[53]图像与主体最接近的训练图像相似性.
在25个悬停的提示下,在4个采样种子的触发词中,方向矢量达到73%至95%的DreamBooth LoRA比基模型的相似性增益.
他们转载了主体粗糙的外表,但错过了细细的身份细节,如猫玩具(图S5)的画面和仙人掌人物的刺.
一个LORA,其参数与方向矢量一样多,达到收益的94%到100%,并更经常地保存这些细节.
没有触发词,方向矢量的相似性增益就低于DreamBooth LoRA本身,或者与它没有明显区别.
基础模型可能已经部分了解一个公共主题。
因此,我们还创造了六个虚构的人,三个女人和三个男人。

FLUX.1-dev的DreamBooth LoRA从这10个图像中学习每个人,方向矢量和相同大小的LORA都和上面一样适应.
身份相似性是ArcFace [12] 最大面孔在图像中与最接近的训练图像的余弦相似性.

blocks.en: H Limitations
blocks.zh: H 限制

blocks.en:
Steering vectors suffice to recover most of each RL-tuned model’s reward gain ( Sec. 4.2 ).
We make no claim of necessity, that the RL-tuned model itself needs the steering vectors to reach its gain.
Nor do we claim that RL post-training is low-rank.
The steering vectors recover most of the gain of RL-tuned models trained as LoRAs and of two full fine-tunes alike, so their few parameters do not imply a low-rank RL update.
On video, the claim covers two RL-tuned models on two base models, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B and Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, and not video RL post-training in general.

引导矢量足以回收大多数RL调制模型的奖励收益(第4.2节)。

Table S14 tests whether the steering vectors solve the same prompts and starting noises as the RL-tuned model.
A pair is one test prompt and one sampling seed, on the GenEval test set of 553 prompts with four sampling seeds and the OCR test set of 1,018 prompts with three sampling seeds.
A pair counts as solved when GenEval’s check is correct or when the text read from the image matches the quoted text exactly.
The base model solves 66.1% of the GenEval pairs and 21.4% of the OCR pairs, the RL-tuned models 94.0% and 62.9%, and the steering vectors 93.0% and 60.2%.
These rates average over pairs, whereas the GenEval score of Tab. 1 averages over the six tasks, so the GenEval gains of the two differ.
Of the 641 GenEval pairs that the base model fails and the GenEval-tuned model solves, the steering vectors also solve 91.4%, with no detected difference from the 93.3% that the GenEval-tuned model itself solves at the next sampling seed of the same prompt.
Of the 1,382 such OCR pairs, the steering vectors solve 75.3%, which exceeds the OCR-tuned model’s own 71.6% at the next sampling seed by + 3.8 +3.8 [ + 0.7 +0.7 , + 6.8 +6.8 ] points.
The mean-difference steering vectors solve 30.1% of the GenEval pairs that the GenEval-tuned model fixes.
A same-size LoRA fitted by Eq. 2 solves 90.6% of these GenEval pairs.
At sampling seed 0, the one seed with OCR scores for this LoRA, it solves 75.4% of the 460 OCR pairs that the OCR-tuned model fixes, and the steering vectors solve 77.6%.
On both sets, no difference between the same-size LoRA and the steering vectors is detected.
On the pairs that both the base model and the RL-tuned model fail, the steering vectors solve 33.3% of 108 on GenEval and 27.3% of 1,017 on OCR.

Finding 2 of Sec. 5 removes most of the OCR-tuned model’s gain by replacing the text keys and values that its image queries read with those of the base model.
If the steering vectors carry the change that RL makes to these keys and values, computing them with the steered base model should restore the gain.
We therefore repeat the replacement on the OCR-tuned model, with the text keys and values computed by the base model plus the OCR steering vectors on the same noisy state, on the OCR test set of 1,018 prompts at one sampling seed.
The OCR-tuned model then keeps 95.2% [91.9, 98.6] of its gain, against 26.4% [20.7, 31.6] with the keys and values of the unsteered base model.
With the PickScore steering vectors in place of the OCR steering vectors, it keeps 44.0% [38.2, 49.5], so the restored gain is specific to the reward that the steering vectors were fitted for.
blocks.zh:
Sec. 5的Find 2通过将其图像查询读取的文本密钥和值替换为基准模型的文本密钥和值,取消了OCR调制模型的大部分收益.
如果方向向量承担了RL对这些键和值所做的改变,用方向盘基模型计算它们应恢复收益.
因此,我们重复在OCR调制模型上替换文字键和值,由基数模型计算,加上OCR方向向量在同一噪声状态上,在1个取样种子上1,018个导电符的OCR测试集上。
OCR调制模型随后保留了95.2%[91.9,98.6]的收益率,而26.4%[20.7,31.6]则保留了未调制基模型的键和值.
PickScore方向矢量取代OCR方向矢量,保持了44.0%[38.2,49.5],因此恢复的增益是针对方向矢量所适应的奖励.
